description: A utility class 'Utils' mainly for parsing date/time strings, matching regex patterns, and working with GregorianCalendar objects. The class is part of the 'com.android.bugreport.util' package and provides static methods and constants for date/time handling, regex matching, and common utils used throughout the bug report tools.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A collection of static utility methods for parsing and handling date-time strings, regex operations, and other common functions used in the bug report tool.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the given text matches the provided Matcher after resetting it.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Returns the Matcher after resetting and matching with the text if it matches; null otherwise.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a regex matcher group or returns a default if the group is null or empty.

methods.name: parseCalendar
methods.description: Creates a GregorianCalendar object from matched date/time groups, with optional milliseconds.
